inputs.description: Password of the administrator account admin, created at the first start. Change it in Memos after you sign in; the Secret is not applied again.
inputs.name: adminPassword

zh-CN.summary: 笔记服务，数据用 SQLite 存在卷上，并预先建好管理员账号。

zh-TW.summary: 筆記服務，資料用 SQLite 存在磁碟區，並先建好管理員帳號。

metadata.name: Memos
metadata.summary: A note-taking app with SQLite on a volume and an admin account ready.

zh-CN.summary: 以 UID 10001 运行，文件系统只读，没有 Kubernetes 令牌，也去掉了所有额外的系统权限。对外连接没有限制。公开注册已关闭。

zh-TW.summary: 以 UID 10001 執行，檔案系統唯讀，沒有 Kubernetes 權杖，也拿掉了所有額外的系統權限。對外連線沒有限制。公開註冊已關閉。

zh-CN.mitigation: ConfigMap memos-config 声明了 admin 账号和自动生成的密码，Memos 在启动时、开始处理请求之前就会建好账号。如果配置应用失败，Memos 会退出，Pod 也不会收到任何流量。
zh-CN.risk: 全新的实例上，第一个创建的账号会变成管理员。

zh-TW.mitigation: ConfigMap memos-config 宣告了 admin 帳號和自動產生的密碼，Memos 在啟動時、開始處理請求之前就會建好帳號。如果設定套用失敗，Memos 會結束，Pod 也不會收到任何流量。
zh-TW.risk: 全新的實例上，第一個建立的帳號會變成管理員。

risks.mitigation: The memos-config ConfigMap declares the account admin with the generated password, and Memos creates it at startup before it serves any request. If the configuration cannot be applied, Memos exits and the Pod receives no traffic.
risks.risk: On an empty instance, the first account created becomes the administrator.

zh-CN.mitigation: ConfigMap memos-config 已开启 disallowUserRegistration。账号由管理员在设置里创建。常规设置由这个 ConfigMap 管理，要修改就编辑这个 ConfigMap，再重启 Pod。
zh-CN.risk: 任何人都可能自己注册账号。

zh-TW.mitigation: ConfigMap memos-config 已開啟 disallowUserRegistration。帳號由管理員在設定裡建立。一般設定由這個 ConfigMap 管理，要修改就編輯這個 ConfigMap，再重新啟動 Pod。
zh-TW.risk: 任何人都可能自己註冊帳號。

risks.mitigation: The memos-config ConfigMap turns on disallowUserRegistration. The administrator creates accounts in Settings. This ConfigMap controls the general settings, so to change them, edit the ConfigMap and restart the Pod.

zh-CN.mitigation: Memos 默认会拦掉指向私有地址的 webhook。模板没有限制对外连接，需要限制时，请加一条 egress NetworkPolicy（限制对外连接的规则）。
zh-CN.risk: Webhook 和链接预览会让服务器去访问用户指定的地址。

zh-TW.mitigation: Memos 預設會擋掉指向私有位址的 webhook。範本沒有限制對外連線，需要限制時，請加一條 egress NetworkPolicy（限制對外連線的規則）。
zh-TW.risk: Webhook 和連結預覽會讓伺服器去連使用者指定的位址。

risks.mitigation: Memos blocks private webhook targets by default. The template does not limit outbound traffic. To limit it, add an egress NetworkPolicy (a rule that limits outbound traffic).
risks.risk: Webhooks and link previews make the server request addresses that users choose.

security.summary: The container runs as UID 10001 with a read-only filesystem, no Kubernetes token and all extra system privileges removed. Outbound traffic is not limited. Public sign-up is off.

manifests:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: memos-data
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 10Gi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: memos-config
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
data:
  instance.json: |
    {
      "instanceSettings": [
        {"name": "instance/settings/GENERAL", "generalSetting": {"disallowUserRegistration": true}}
      ],
      "users": [
        {"name": "users/admin", "username": "admin", "role": "ADMIN", "password": "${env:ADMIN_PASSWORD}"}
      ]
    }
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: memos
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  serviceName: memos
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: memos
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        templates.zeabur.com/template: memos
        app.kubernetes.io/name: memos
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        fsGroup: 10001
        fsGroupChangePolicy: OnRootMismatch
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
      - name: memos
        image: neosmemo/memos:26.11.0@sha256:087e7dc6b76b31fcd1107a5767398b2a310ced209adb791efd8760c745dc8034
        ports:
        - name: http
          containerPort: 5230
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop: [ALL]
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 50m
            memory: 128Mi
          limits:
            cpu: '1'
            memory: 512Mi
        env:
        - name: MEMOS_PORT
          value: '5230'
        - name: MEMOS_DATA
          value: /var/opt/memos
        - name: MEMOS_DRIVER
          value: sqlite
        - name: MEMOS_INSTANCE_URL
          value: https://{{ .Domain }}
        - name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: memos-secrets
              key: admin-password
        volumeMounts:
        - name: data
          mountPath: /var/opt/memos
        - name: config
          mountPath: /etc/memos/config
          readOnly: true
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp
        startupProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /healthz
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 60
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /healthz
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 10
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /healthz
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 20
          failureThreshold: 6
      volumes:
      - name: data
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: memos-data
      - name: config
        configMap:
          name: memos-config
      - name: tmp
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 512Mi
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: memos
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: memos
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 5230
    targetPort: http
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: memos
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
  annotations:
    cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: '{{ .ClusterIssuer }}'
spec:
  ingressClassName: traefik
  tls:
  - hosts: ['{{ .Domain }}']
    secretName: memos-tls
  rules:
  - host: '{{ .Domain }}'
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: memos
            port:
              number: 5230
